rule.name: SubtractionComparison
rule.message: This comparator returns the difference of two numbers. A difference of two ints overflows for large or negative values, and (int) of a long, float or double difference truncates, so two values that differ can compare as equal or in the wrong order, and sorting then fails only on some data (Comparison method violates its general contract). Compare with Integer.compare(a.line, b.line), Long.compare(a.time, b.time) or Double.compare(a.x, b.x), or build the comparator with Comparator.comparingInt(Item::count). An exception fits operands that are bounded by construction, such as sizes, lengths, ordinals, buffer positions and limits, status codes, chars, bytes and shorts. Two int parameters compared by a plain subtraction are left to the integer-slip check.
